description: Baseline setup: Standard Cross-Entropy (smoothing 0.05), clean train, dropout 0.40
Loss Experiment: Class-Weighted Cross-Entropy (weights derived strictly from train labels)
Loss Experiment: Focal Loss (gamma=1.5, class-weighted) targeting hard boundary classes
Loss Experiment: Focal Loss (gamma=2.0, class-weighted) with increased hard-example focus
Augmentation Experiment: Clinically safe augmentations (HFlip, +/-8 deg rot, mild jitter) + Focal Loss
Fine-Tuning Experiment: Tuned dropout 0.35, weight decay 1.2e-4 with augmented dataset and Focal Loss
Optimized Checkpoint: ConvNeXt + Swin Gated Fusion, Cosine Annealing, Class-Weighted Focal Loss (gamma=1.5)
